incident-bot: ALERT: Unusual KV cache growth + paging observed in eu-west-2 (eviction_rate=15% 5m, paging_io=high) :rotating_light:
Priya N: noticed after the GPTQ/awq mixed rollout at 14:03 UTC — p50 fine, p95 for streaming routes jumped from 300ms -> 1.9s
dev-ryan: seeing a large increase in avg_kv_bytes_per_request on models using awq-mix-1 (configs show chunk_size=512 -> 1024)
eng-runtime: confirmed. The new allocator alignment and per-chunk header for awq-mix-1 seems to add ~200B overhead per KV chunk; under continuous batching this multiplies.
sre-maya: customer impact? ops-customer: two customer tenants reported degraded throughput and intermittent 502s for long-context chat. They saw retries spike ~6x.
Priya N: quick logs:
```
2026-04-02T14:08:21Z [serving] req=xyz kv_chunks=78 kv_total=96MB evict=27 spill_io=480MB
2026-04-02T14:08:22Z [cont-batch] batch_id=cb-900 latency_p95=1.87s
```
eng-runtime: immediate mitigation plan: (A) reduce cont-batch.max_concurrent_requests  from 64 -> 16, (B) set cont-batch.batch_window_ms from 12 -> 6, (C) disable prefix_kv_cache on awq lanes for eu-west-2. Rolling now.
deploy-bot: DEPLOY START user=eng-runtime commit=hotfix/awq-kv-throttle ts=1758880150
Priya N: after changes, eviction_rate dropped to ~4% after 60s; paging_io decreased by ~70%.
Lena H: I prefer we also flip kernel selection to gptq-fallback for awq-mix-1 on suspect hosts (policy: prefer-stable-kernel) — that reduces alignment padding by forcing an older allocation path.
eng-runtime: will flip selector on a small canary first (2 hosts) in eu-west-2, monitoring kv_size_hist and evictions.
sre-maya: adjusting alerts to reduce noise and creating a temporary suppression for lower severity while on-call monitors.
ops-customer: we've notified affected customers; one asked for root cause and ETA. Told them initial mitigation in place, full rollback or patch expected within 6-8 hours.
Priya N: triage notes: potential causes = (1) awq allocator alignment bump, (2) cont-batch growth (more small requests aggregated), (3) new per-chunk header in awq-mix-1. Likely interaction of (1) and (2).
eng-runtime: action items:
- capture heap and per-request kv histograms for models awq-mix-1 and gptq-compat across mid/long contexts (assigned @dev-ryan)
- run synthetic long-context sim to repro amplification (assigned @Priya N)
- plan rollback of awq-mix-1 allocator alignment or make header optional (assigned @eng-runtime)
- add quota guard to cont-batch to cap total_kv_bytes per-batch (engine change)
Priya N: handoff to night on-call: @sre-maya. Notes attached: throttle in place (max_concurrent=16, batch_window_ms=6), kernel selector canary running, metrics to watch: kv_total, evict_rate, paging_io, p95_stream
sre-maya: ack. I'll keep the suppression and escalate if evictions creep above 8% or paging_io back to high.

Priya N: severity S2 (partial customer impact, mitigated). Creating postmortem draft and linking ticket INC-2026-331 in #postmortems.
